limitations: Original PNG views have no calibrated physical scale or cameras; absolute size/hidden surfaces are authored estimates.
Contact probes record actual intersections or sampled solid witnesses. A contact is not evidence of natural anatomical placement or exact source shape.
Sampled nearest surface gap is not a certified global minimum. Separate held components can be intentional projectiles/effects, and require source-aware review before changing.
